integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic surreal body horror, photorealistic. <Subject 1> stands facing the camera in a tiled changing room at a public swimming pool, framed from the waist up, dressed so that the neck and upper chest are clearly visible. The camera pushes in at slow speed. A single fine ivory filament emerges from a tiny point in the skin at the centre of the sternum, clearly growing out of the body itself. <Subject 1> pinches it between two fingers and pulls steadily outward, and the body changes in direct response: a narrow band of <Subject 1> unwinds and becomes the same continuous filament, and every new length pulled out removes another visible strip of volume. The unwinding path travels across the chest toward one shoulder, which shrinks and simplifies; the upper arm thins from shoulder to elbow. Loops of ivory filament gather around the feet. The body does not tear or bleed; it is smoothly converted into one continuous strand. <Subject 1> pauses, a great length stretched between hand and body. In the final moment the loose end begins moving on its own and draws another short length out of <Subject 1>, and <Subject 1> lowers their gaze toward it.

overall_soundscape: Quiet room ambience, restrained breathing, a continuous fine sliding sound as the filament leaves the body, and soft loops landing on the floor.
